about: Every recall card key of Producers and flagships, in the roster’s order: ‘Cask Houses · <pick key>/<card id>’, two a house. The pick’s key comes from plan.json and the card’s short id from its fragment; nothing is minted, so a reworded card and a swapped bottling keep their keys. A question has no key of its own: it carries the key of the card it is paired with. While frozen is false this file follows the writing build (build-caskhouses.mjs) and a key that leaves is printed. Once the integrator has run build-caskhouses.mjs --freeze, with the roster whole, a build may add a key and never loses one: a lost key refuses the build, because a key is a person’s saved record.
